external_pim_evidence.blocked_reason: PIM authority has NOT established (a) the exact unit-level T108 -> DIST-P108 relationship, nor (b) the exact ProcessConnection endpoint at DIST-P108. Names/descriptions must not be reinterpreted and F05 aggregation must not be treated as authority.

authority.statement: G17A is a planning/review gate only. No decision in this artifact authorizes runtime execution, creates BoundaryPorts/CompositionBindings, adds federation participants, broadens G12C admission, adds Gauss-Seidel/iterative/multirate policy, invents plant values, or changes T106/T108/G4/G7/G14/G15/PIM. The recommended next gate is a planning recommendation only and must NOT be started in G17A.

PIM_AUTHORITATIVE_TOPOLOGY.meaning: Topology derived from PIM semantic authority (canonical relations/exports).
PIM_AUTHORITATIVE_TOPOLOGY.status_for_t108_to_dist_p108: STILL_BLOCKED — exact relation and ProcessConnection endpoint NOT ESTABLISHED by PIM.
PIM_AUTHORITATIVE_TOPOLOGY.rule: Never fabricated by VF; never inferred from names/descriptions/aggregates.

VF_SCENARIO_ASSUMED_TOPOLOGY.meaning: Topology carried as an explicit, versioned, provenance-bearing, reversible synthetic scenario assumption (simulation/design stage only).
constraints: assumption is explicit / versioned / provenanced / reversible
no silent promotion of assumption to site truth
VF_SCENARIO_ASSUMED_TOPOLOGY.no_back_propagation: VF assumptions never flow back into PIM/KG authority; no claim of measured/site-verified/source-mapped/calibrated truth.

classification_vocabulary.meaning: Planning classification only. NOT runtime authorization.

architecture_inspected.g4_composition: src/virtual_factory/composition/{graph,ports,transfer,participant,coordinator}.py — generic CompositionGraph (separate from containment, cycles allowed), typed BoundaryPort (material/utility/information/coordination), immutable detached BoundaryTransfer, mechanism-neutral ExecutableParticipant, deterministic fail-closed Coordinator (validate->advance->stage->validate-transfers->commit->finalize).
architecture_inspected.g7_run_control: src/virtual_factory/runcontrol/{targets,lifecycle,assy_bridge,continuous_bridge}.py — hierarchical target resolution, RunLifecycleService (CREATED/RUNNING/PAUSED/STOPPED/FAILED), replay pins scenario_id + fresh run_id lineage, attempt isolation.
architecture_inspected.g5_federation: src/virtual_factory/federation/{tipa_workspace,assy_participant,assy_host}.py — 6 ASSY sub-line participants via AssySubLineAdapter (no cross-scope value exchange at boundaries).
architecture_inspected.g14a_projection: src/virtual_factory/shwtp/projection.py — exactly F01 T106->T108: 2 BoundaryPorts + 1 CompositionBinding, inert.
architecture_inspected.g14b_federation: src/virtual_factory/shwtp/federation.py — T106->T108 explicit_lagged coupling (orchestration policy, NOT a CompositionGraph property); 2 participants with detached transfer.
architecture_inspected.g15_evaluation: src/virtual_factory/shwtp/evaluation.py — SH-WTP-specific per-window evaluation rows + mass-balance residual; lag_windows=1 metadata.
architecture_inspected.frontend_inspection: src/virtual_factory/ui/{api.py,hierarchy.py,runtime_service.py} + static/ — continuous dashboard (charts), assy-demo, G6 hierarchy UI, G7 /vnext/runs endpoints, /health, run_control_context.js. No CompositionGraph visualization, no generic federation inspection surface.
architecture_inspected.replay_provenance: src/virtual_factory/provenance/{context,envelope,namespace,adapter}.py — RunContextV2 immutable identity; G7 replay over TIPA/continuous (federated replay NOT yet proven).

workstreams.name: multi-participant federation generalization (>2 executable participants)
workstreams.readiness: G4 Coordinator is N-participant deterministic; G5 registers 6 ASSY participants (no cross-scope exchange); G14B proves 2 participants WITH detached value exchange. >2 participants WITH exchange is NOT yet proven.
workstreams.architecture_risk_if_done_now: Low — additive above G4; must not change coordinator/transfer semantics or coupling-policy location.
workstreams.rationale: Pure platform capability testable with synthetic participants; directly de-risks whole-plant federation (many scopes exchanging at boundaries).

workstreams.name: generic coordinator/runtime lifecycle hardening
workstreams.readiness: G4 Coordinator + G7 RunLifecycleService exist and are tested; hardening (edge cases, stale-window, duplicate registration, ordering) is platform work.
workstreams.architecture_risk_if_done_now: Low — additive; must preserve fail-closed and no-rollback-claim semantics.
workstreams.rationale: Lifecycle/coordination correctness is mechanism-level and independent of plant truth.

workstreams.name: deterministic replay across federated participants
workstreams.readiness: G7 replay exists for TIPA/continuous (pins scenario_id, fresh run_id + source_run_id lineage); G14B federation determinism proven per-test; no federated replay entrypoint yet.
workstreams.architecture_risk_if_done_now: Low — replay pins prior inputs and must never overwrite prior run or fabricate missing inputs.
workstreams.rationale: Deterministic replay is a verification capability, independent of plant truth.

workstreams.name: federation diagnostics generalization beyond SH-WTP two-scope trace
workstreams.readiness: G15 diagnostics are SH-WTP-specific (hardcoded T106/T108 fields). No generic per-window diagnostic trace over arbitrary participants.
workstreams.architecture_risk_if_done_now: Low — read-only diagnostic layer; must not change runtime truth.
workstreams.rationale: Diagnostics generalization is platform work; no plant truth needed.

workstreams.name: evaluation trace abstraction/generalization
workstreams.readiness: G15 ShwtpEvaluationRow/Summary are SH-WTP-specific schemas. No generic evaluation-row schema.
workstreams.architecture_risk_if_done_now: Low — schema-level generalization; must preserve exact-residual semantics where they exist.
workstreams.rationale: Platform-level trace schema, independent of plant truth.

workstreams.name: scenario input handling
workstreams.readiness: RunContextV2 carries scenario_id/scenario_version; G7 pins a single scenario authority per run; continuous/ASSY have scenario loaders. No variable per-window scenario scheduler (explicit G15 non-objective).
workstreams.architecture_risk_if_done_now: Low — scenario IDENTITY/version/pinning is mechanism; scenario VALUES that encode plant physics remain evidence-gated.
workstreams.rationale: Scenario input HANDLING is platform; scenario physics VALUES are plant-truth-gated (kept separate).

workstreams.name: orchestration-policy abstraction (seam only, no new policy implementation)
workstreams.readiness: G14B froze explicit_lagged as an ORCHESTRATION policy NOT on CompositionGraph/BoundaryPort/Binding. No generic policy seam/interface yet.
workstreams.architecture_risk_if_done_now: Low if seam-only; HIGH if a new policy (Gauss-Seidel/iterative/multirate) is implemented — FORBIDDEN in this gate.
workstreams.rationale: Abstracting the policy SEAM preserves coupling policy as orchestration policy and de-risks future whole-plant coupling choices.

workstreams.name: runtime inspection/introspection
workstreams.readiness: Existing: /health, /vnext/runs (TIPA/continuous), assy-demo snapshots, continuous telemetry. No generic composition/federation run inspection surface.
workstreams.architecture_risk_if_done_now: Low — read-only additive projection.
workstreams.rationale: Inspection is read-only and mechanism-level.

workstreams.name: composition/topology visualization
workstreams.readiness: CompositionGraph (G4) + G14A F01 graph exist and serialize deterministically. No UI renders them.
workstreams.architecture_risk_if_done_now: Low — read-only visualization; must not imply topology == execution order.
workstreams.rationale: Visualization of existing graphs is platform UI; no plant truth needed.

workstreams.name: run status / health state
workstreams.readiness: G7 RunState (CREATED/RUNNING/PAUSED/STOPPED/FAILED) + /health + run_control_context.js exist. No per-federated-window health projection.
workstreams.architecture_risk_if_done_now: Low — additive read-only projection.
workstreams.rationale: Run status/health is mechanism-level.

workstreams.name: multi-scope runtime UI shell
workstreams.readiness: G6 hierarchy UI + run_control_context.js already shell TIPA + continuous. A new generic multi-scope shell has no wider federated runtime to shell over yet.
workstreams.architecture_risk_if_done_now: Medium — building a shell before the runtime exists risks inventing scope semantics.
workstreams.rationale: Value only materializes once the federated/whole-plant runtime exists; premature now.

workstreams.name: alarms/events for simulation runtime
workstreams.readiness: G3 observation/event/alarm fact mechanism exists (mechanism-neutral, downstream of runtime). No alarm/event surface over the SH-WTP federation runtime; domain alarm RULES are plant-truth-gated.
workstreams.architecture_risk_if_done_now: Medium — generic mechanism is safe but domain alarm rules would invent plant semantics.
workstreams.rationale: The fact mechanism (G3) already exists; the runtime-facing alarm surface and domain rules wait for runtime expansion + domain truth.

workstreams.name: online charts for current simulation values only
workstreams.readiness: Continuous dashboard already charts current values; extending the same read-only charting to federation windows is additive UI.
workstreams.architecture_risk_if_done_now: Low — read-only UI.
workstreams.rationale: Charting current simulation values is mechanism-level.

workstreams.name: generic boundary/port monitoring
workstreams.readiness: G4 BoundaryTransfer/PortRef are inert and frozen; no read-only monitoring of staged/committed transfers yet.
workstreams.architecture_risk_if_done_now: Low — read-only observation over G4 transfers; must not add mutation.
workstreams.rationale: Monitoring declared boundary exchange is platform-level.

workstreams.name: failure propagation semantics across participants
workstreams.readiness: G4 Coordinator already fails closed (advance failure stops window; transfer validation failure prevents commit; commit failure stops further commits). Generalizing across >2 participants is platform work.
workstreams.architecture_risk_if_done_now: Low — additive; must preserve fail-closed + no-false-rollback-claim.
workstreams.rationale: Failure propagation is mechanism-level; independent of plant truth.

workstreams.name: participant attempt isolation / lifecycle invariants
workstreams.readiness: G7 attempt isolation (fresh run_id, terminal never reused), G13/G13B reset/attempt isolation, G14B fresh-attempt isolation all tested. Federated-level hardening is additive.
workstreams.architecture_risk_if_done_now: Low — additive; must preserve fresh-identity invariants.
workstreams.rationale: Attempt isolation/lifecycle invariants are mechanism-level.

workstreams.name: support for heterogeneous executable scope archetypes
workstreams.readiness: G4 participant is mechanism-neutral; G5 (discrete ASSY) and G14B (logical/first-order SH-WTP) already adapt to it. Adding archetype adapters is platform work.
workstreams.architecture_risk_if_done_now: Low — adapter-level; must not retype domain runtime behavior.
workstreams.rationale: Archetype MECHANISM is platform; specific domain runtimes remain evidence-gated.

workstreams.name: future coupling-policy extension seam
workstreams.readiness: G14B docstring explicitly reserves future sequential/Gauss-Seidel/iterative/adaptive/multirate policies ABOVE the unchanged composition graph. The SEAM (interface/registry) is not yet extracted.
workstreams.architecture_risk_if_done_now: Low if seam-only; HIGH if a new policy is implemented — FORBIDDEN in this gate.
workstreams.rationale: The extension seam is platform; keeps coupling policy as orchestration policy.

workstreams.name: whole-plant SH-WTP execution
workstreams.readiness: G16 classified whole-plant runtime NOT_AUTHORIZED / NOT_IMPLEMENTED; many units LogicalOnly with unknown plant values (GAP-SHW-001/003).
workstreams.architecture_risk_if_done_now: HIGH — would require bypassing explicit boundary/projection gates and broadening site/runtime authority.
workstreams.rationale: Requires plant semantic authority and topology truth not yet established.

workstreams.name: DIST-P108 runtime / projection / federation
workstreams.readiness: G16 marked DIST-P108 NEXT_SLICE_CANDIDATE but conditioned on PIM confirming the exact T108->DIST-P108 relation; verdict STILL_INSUFFICIENT.
workstreams.architecture_risk_if_done_now: HIGH — authoritative projection/federation would fabricate PIM canonical identity; a VF_SCENARIO_ASSUMED_TOPOLOGY instance is the only permitted future path (see recommended_next_gate).
workstreams.rationale: Blocked by unresolved plant semantic authority.

workstreams.name: T110 runtime
workstreams.readiness: G12C admission = BLOCKED_PENDING_EVIDENCE (WASH-T110); G16 reaffirmed.
workstreams.architecture_risk_if_done_now: HIGH — G10/G12C frozen T110 below runtime admission.
workstreams.rationale: Blocked by PIM evidence.

workstreams.name: Line 2 runtime
workstreams.readiness: G16 classified L2-T101/T105/T106/T108 REFERENCE_ONLY (PatternInferred).
workstreams.architecture_risk_if_done_now: HIGH — PatternInferred promotion to runtime candidate is forbidden (G16).
workstreams.rationale: Blocked by PIM evidence.

workstreams.name: chemical/electrical/automation runtime
workstreams.readiness: G16 classified CHEM-DOSING / ELEC-MCC / AUTO-PLC REFERENCE_ONLY (IndustryExpected/PatternInferred).
workstreams.architecture_risk_if_done_now: HIGH — would invent domain physics/control semantics.
workstreams.rationale: Blocked by PIM evidence.

dependency_matrix.note: Rows depend on columns. Platform rows (WS-01..WS-18) depend only on accepted G4/G7/G14/G15 platform seams; plant rows (WS-19..WS-23) additionally depend on PIM authority.

recommended_next_gate.title: Generic scenario-topology overlay (VF_SCENARIO_ASSUMED_TOPOLOGY) capability
recommended_next_gate.summary: Build the smallest bounded platform mechanism to declare, version, provenance, and reversibly apply explicit synthetic scenario topology assumptions that are visibly distinct from PIM-authoritative topology. First illustrative use-case: carry T108 -> DIST-P108 as a VF_SCENARIO_ASSUMED_TOPOLOGY edge (NOT authoritative, NOT PIM-derived).

criteria_satisfaction.criterion: independent of unresolved T108->DIST-P108 semantic authority
criteria_satisfaction.note: The mechanism is generic and does not resolve or depend on PIM authority; PIM is untouched.

criteria_satisfaction.criterion: materially reduces risk for future whole-plant federation
criteria_satisfaction.note: Enforces the assumed-vs-authoritative topology separation that whole-plant federation with incomplete PIM evidence requires.

criteria_satisfaction.criterion: does not broaden SH-WTP runtime authorization
criteria_satisfaction.note: Assumptions are synthetic-reference only; vf_runtime_authorization stays NOT_AUTHORIZED.

criteria_satisfaction.criterion: does not require new plant physics or topology truth
criteria_satisfaction.note: Assumptions are explicitly synthetic and reversible.
Overlay is scenario-level provenance, not a CompositionGraph semantic.

criteria_satisfaction.criterion: preserves coupling policy as orchestration policy
criteria_satisfaction.note: No coupling-policy change; policy remains above the graph.
Additive above G4; G4 semantics unchanged.

must_preserve: assumption is explicit / versioned / provenanced / reversible
no silent promotion of assumption to site truth

deferred_blocked: Gauss-Seidel / iterative / multirate policy implementation (FORBIDDEN; only the seam may be abstracted)
architecture_invariants: Containment hierarchy remains a tree; composition/connectivity is a separate graph.
CompositionGraph != execution order; coordinator ordering never depends on topological sort.
Coordinator is a composition service, not a domain simulation engine.
Inter-scope exchange only through declared boundary contracts/ports; detached immutable transfers.
Coupling policy is an orchestration policy, NOT a CompositionGraph/BoundaryPort/Binding property.
Runtime truth stays inside child runtimes; coordinator owns sequencing/context only.
PIM remains canonical semantic authority; boundary ports never fabricate PIM canonical IDs.
Run/provenance identity remains authoritative; no second run/provenance model.
G3 Observation/Event/Alarm remain downstream facts, never runtime authority.
AssyLineRuntime is never rewritten; continuous/compressor baselines preserved.
no_runtime_authorization: G17A changed no runtime behavior. vf_runtime_authorization = NOT_AUTHORIZED; site_authorized_execution = NOT_AUTHORIZED; whole_plant_runtime = NOT_AUTHORIZED / NOT_IMPLEMENTED. The recommended next gate is a planning recommendation only and is NOT started in G17A.
